test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the highlighted idiom.

The team members seem to be **running around in circles**.

options.text: To be very active but with few results

solution:
The correct answer is '**To be very active but with few results**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The meaning of the idiom '**running around in circles**' is '**to be very active but with few results**'.
